text:
kevin_sales: Flagging Cerulean POC — security team tightened identity & provisioning requirements. Need a quick tech presales sync to confirm we can meet their checklist by Fri.

sophie_se: I can jump on. What are the non-negotiables?

kevin_sales: They require SSO (SAML IdP + SP initiated), SCIM v2 with delta and bulk import support, group->role assignment during provisioning, delegated tenant admins, domain-locked provisioning (no self-serve), and SIEM forwarding for audit logs in near-real time.

raj_security: Also: BYOK mandatory (customer KMS), HSM/FIPS reference, immutable audit trail, and ability to show rotation events for keys. They asked for retention options >=365 days for logs.

mila_pm: Product notes: Dedicated POC cluster is fine. Default audit retention is 90 days; we can enable 180 or 365 on the enterprise toggle. SIEM forwarding supported via HTTP webhook or syslog; latency is ~30s typical. File-upload domain verification can be accommodated for a POC through support (we manually verify and lock tenant).

sophie_se: SCIM specifics: we support /Users and /Groups plus a ChangeLog delta endpoint. Rate limits: we can provision 1500 ops/min for enterprise POCs; bulk imports over 100k users are handled by an async import pipeline. Important: our RBAC engine does not yet auto-consume a "role" attribute inside SCIM Group objects.

cerulean_it: For mapping, our IdP (Okta) can send a custom attribute on Group with "role=prod_admin". We expect the platform to translate that into tenant role on provisioning.

sophie_se: Noted. Today the options are: 1) admin-side role-mapping API which you can call post-provisioning, or 2) run a short webhook/lambda that listens to SCIM events and calls the admin API to create the mapping. We can demo both.

sophie_se: Example pseudo-workflow for the lambda (short):

  1) Subscribe to SCIM ChangeLog webhook for Groups.
  2) When group appears with custom attribute role, call POST /admin/role-mappings with {group:..., role:...} using an admin token.

  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/role-mappings \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"group":"okta:cerulean-admins","role":"tenant_admin"}'

owen_billing: On credits: we can support 300k tokens/day for a short POC under credits. Anything above requires a paid uplift or a minimal commit; I can put a short SOW together with overage paths.

raj_security: For the security questionnaire: we can confirm AWS/GCP/Azure KMS BYOK and non-exportable keys. For HSM/FIPS they want an attestation doc; we have a compliance pack that covers our hosting and KMS integrations. Key rotation: we record CMK rotation events in audit logs and can surface them in the questionnaire.

compliance_bot: sec_scan: SAML metadata validation for cerulean-okta-idp passed (scan 1775551500). audit_retention: default 90d (enterprise opts: 180d, 365d).

mila_pm: A few POC caveats to communicate: 1) automated UI role-mapping is planned in a later release; the admin-API/lambda workaround is a supported POC pattern. 2) Domain file-upload verification is manual for POCs and may add an extra day. 3) If they need SIEM forwarding to a private network endpoint we may need a connector or tunnel.

kevin_sales: Action items: Sophie -> runbook with SSO screenshots + SCIM chunking guidance + mapping lambda sample. Owen -> draft SOW/credits and overage path. Raj -> complete security questionnaire answers + attach compliance pack. Mila -> note caveats in deal doc and schedule tech preflight.

cerulean_it: We expect ~25k users initially and will do a one-time bulk import of ~60k users. Peak tokens/day anticipated ~350k during heavy eval. Will upload domain verification file today.

owen_billing: Given expected usage, we'll propose credits for 300k tokens/day and itemize an overage rate for the extra 50k. I'll send the SOW this afternoon.

raj_security: I'll prepare the BYOK/HSM sections and rotate proof screenshots; aim to attach by EOD.

sophie_se: Will have the runbook + lambda example ready by tomorrow 11am PT.

mila_pm: Scheduling a 40m tech preflight for tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll invite Cerulean and include the runbook when Sophie posts it.

kevin_sales: Thanks team. I'll follow up with Cerulean to confirm they uploaded the file and to set expectations around the manual verification window.
